# Purpose

Two things, in order:

1. **Validate** our ≥1-locus supermatrix tree (from Step 2) against the published, time-calibrated
   Danaini phylogeny of **Chazot et al. (2021)**, with a congruence visualization: our tree pruned
   to the species shared with Chazot, internal nodes coloured by whether that exact clade is also
   recovered by Chazot and sized by bootstrap support.
2. **Filter** the tree down to the final set of species used downstream, by pruning it to a plain
   list, `input_data/danaini_tree/species_to_keep.txt`.

Why those species? *Tellervo zoilus* is dropped because the comparison below shows its placement in
our tree **conflicts with Chazot** — it does not sit where the reference puts it, so we do not trust
its position and exclude it. The remaining species in the keep-list are the ingroup species that are
represented in our curated HOSTS host-plant dataset, plus the outgroups that are represented in the
general HOSTS dataset (*Mechanitis polymnia*, *Heliconius erato*). That membership logic was applied
once, by hand, to produce `species_to_keep.txt` — see that file's header for the derivation. This
notebook does **not** re-run any HOSTS logic; it simply prunes the tree to the list, which you can
edit directly.

# 0. Setup

```{r libs}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ape)
  library(ggtree)
  library(phangorn)
})

if (!file.exists("helpers/chazot_congruence.R")) {
  stop("Can't find helpers/ — set the working directory to code/ first.\n",
       "  Current getwd(): ", getwd())
}
source("helpers/chazot_congruence.R")   # load_chazot(), congruence_vs_chazot()  (adapted, Marianna)
source("helpers/supermatrix_tree.R")    # export_tree()  (rooted newick + branch-support table)
```

```{r config}
# Paths are relative to the code/ folder (the working directory).
INPUT_ROOT <- Sys.getenv("DANAINI_INPUT", unset = "../input_data/danaini_tree")
OUT_ROOT   <- Sys.getenv("DANAINI_OUT",   unset = "../output_data/danaini_tree")
FIG_ROOT   <- Sys.getenv("DANAINI_FIG",   unset = "../visuals/danaini_tree")
dir.create(FIG_ROOT, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

TREE_DIR   <- file.path(OUT_ROOT, "supermatrix_ge1")
OUR_TREE   <- file.path(TREE_DIR, "supermatrix_ge1.treefile")
CHAZOT_NEX <- file.path(INPUT_ROOT, "Chazot_Supplementary_Tree_2.nex")
KEEP_LIST  <- file.path(INPUT_ROOT, "species_to_keep.txt")
ROOT_TAXON <- "Heliconius_erato"
```

# 1. Load the two trees

```{r load-trees}
stopifnot(file.exists(OUR_TREE), file.exists(CHAZOT_NEX))
our <- read.tree(OUR_TREE)
if (ROOT_TAXON %in% our$tip.label) our <- root(our, outgroup = ROOT_TAXON, resolve.root = TRUE)
cat("Our tree:", length(our$tip.label), "species\n")

chazot <- load_chazot(CHAZOT_NEX)
cat("Chazot tree:", length(chazot$ref$tip.label), "tips |",
    length(unique(na.omit(chazot$ref_sp))), "distinct species\n")
```

# 2. Congruence with Chazot et al. 2021

```{r congruence, fig.width=8, fig.height=10}
cong <- congruence_vs_chazot(our, chazot,
                             title = "Supermatrix (≥1 locus) — clades recovered in Chazot",
                             root_taxon = ROOT_TAXON)

cat(sprintf("Shared species: %d | clades recovered in Chazot: %d%% | RF = %d (normalized %.3f)\n",
            cong$n_shared, cong$pct_recovered, cong$rf, cong$rf_norm))

ggsave(file.path(FIG_ROOT, "congruence_vs_chazot.png"), cong$plot,
       width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 150)
cong$plot
```

Green nodes are clades our tree recovers that Chazot also recovers; orange nodes conflict. High
overall recovery with conflicts concentrated at weakly supported (small) nodes is the expected,
reassuring pattern.

# 3. Why *Tellervo zoilus* is excluded

*Tellervo zoilus* is one of our outgroup species and is present in the Chazot reference, so it enters
the comparison above. Its placement in our supermatrix tree **does not agree with Chazot** — the
split that subtends it in our tree is not recovered in the reference. We therefore treat its position
as unreliable and drop it from the downstream tree rather than let a misplaced outgroup distort
rooting or host-state reconstruction. The chunk below records its immediate neighbour in each tree so
the disagreement is explicit.

```{r tellervo-check}
TELLERVO <- "Tellervo_zoilus"
neighbour_in <- function(phy) {
  if (!(TELLERVO %in% phy$tip.label)) return(NA_character_)
  tip <- which(phy$tip.label == TELLERVO)
  parent <- phy$edge[phy$edge[, 2] == tip, 1]
  sibs <- phy$edge[phy$edge[, 1] == parent, 2]
  sib_tips <- sibs[sibs != tip & sibs <= length(phy$tip.label)]
  if (length(sib_tips)) paste(phy$tip.label[sib_tips], collapse = ", ") else "(an internal clade)"
}
cat("In our tree, Tellervo_zoilus sits next to:", neighbour_in(cong$our_pruned), "\n")
cat("In Chazot,   Tellervo_zoilus sits next to:", neighbour_in(cong$ref_pruned), "\n")
```

# 4. Filter the tree to the final species set

Prune our tree to `input_data/danaini_tree/species_to_keep.txt` (one `Genus_species` per line;
`#` lines are comments). No HOSTS datasets are read here — the keep-list already encodes that
decision.

```{r filter}
keep <- readLines(KEEP_LIST) |> trimws()
keep <- keep[nzchar(keep) & !startsWith(keep, "#")]
cat("Keep-list:", length(keep), "species\n")

missing <- setdiff(keep, our$tip.label)
if (length(missing))
  warning("Keep-list species absent from the tree (ignored): ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

keep_present <- intersect(keep, our$tip.label)
dropped      <- setdiff(our$tip.label, keep_present)

# `our` is already rooted on Heliconius (§1); keep.tip keeps the rooting and
# node labels, so do NOT re-root (re-rooting misaligns node.label).
filtered <- keep.tip(our, keep_present)

cat("Filtered tree:", length(filtered$tip.label), "species | dropped",
    length(dropped), "\n")
cat("Dropped:", paste(sort(dropped), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r write-filtered, fig.width=8, fig.height=10}
# The filtered tree IS the butterfly phylogeny the figure uses, so write it straight to
# where the figure pipeline reads it (input_data/host_matrix/Danaini_in_HOSTS.newick),
# together with its branch-support table. export_tree() writes the newick + support CSV.
figure_tree <- "../input_data/host_matrix/Danaini_in_HOSTS.newick"
out_support <- file.path(TREE_DIR, "branch_support_filtered.csv")
export_tree(filtered, figure_tree, out_support)

dropped_tbl <- tibble(
  species = sort(dropped),
  reason  = ifelse(species == "Tellervo_zoilus",
                   "placement conflicts with Chazot (see §3)",
                   "not in species_to_keep.txt (absent from curated HOSTS dataset)")
)
write_csv(dropped_tbl, file.path(OUT_ROOT, "filtered_out_species.csv"))

p_filt <- ggtree(filtered) + geom_tiplab(size = 2.4) +
  geom_nodelab(size = 1.8, hjust = -0.2, color = "#2c7fb8") +
  ggtitle(sprintf("Final filtered tree (%d species)", length(filtered$tip.label))) +
  theme_tree2() + xlim(0, NA)
ggsave(file.path(FIG_ROOT, "supermatrix_ge1_filtered_tree.pdf"), p_filt,
       width = 8, height = 10, limitsize = FALSE)

cat("Wrote:", figure_tree,
    "| branch_support_filtered.csv | filtered_out_species.csv | filtered-tree PDF\n")
```

# Notes

- Inputs consumed: `output_data/danaini_tree/supermatrix_ge1/supermatrix_ge1.treefile` (Step 2),
  `input_data/danaini_tree/Chazot_Supplementary_Tree_2.nex`, and
  `input_data/danaini_tree/species_to_keep.txt`.
- Outputs: `visuals/danaini_tree/congruence_vs_chazot.png`; the filtered tree written straight to
  the figure's input as `input_data/host_matrix/Danaini_in_HOSTS.newick`, with its branch-support
  table `output_data/danaini_tree/supermatrix_ge1/branch_support_filtered.csv`;
  `output_data/danaini_tree/filtered_out_species.csv`; and the filtered-tree figure.
- To change which species survive, edit `species_to_keep.txt` and re-run §4 — no code changes needed.
- The filtered tree is rooted on *Heliconius erato*; re-root downstream if your analysis needs a
  different outgroup.
